Main Stages Breakdown
⚔️ Knockout Stage
Date: July 4 - 5
Rounds: 1 round per day, total of 2 rounds
Format: Hosts compete within their regional divisions to qualify.

🔥 Sprint Stage
Date: July 6 - 8
Duration: 3 Days
Format: Total annual votes across 3 days determine advancement.

💥 Revival Stage (Runs in parallel with Sprint)
Date: July 6 - 8
Duration: 1 Round over 3 Days
Format: A second chance for previously eliminated hosts to re-enter the competition.

🌍 Semi-Final (Global Qualification)
Date: July 9 - 10
Rounds: 1 round per day, total of 2 rounds
Outcome: Top hosts earn the right to represent their region in the global stage.

🏁 Regional Finals & Global Ranking Announcement
Date: July 11
Rounds: 1 final round
Highlight: Regional champions are crowned and global rankings are revealed.

🗓️ Warm-Up: July 20 – July 22
⚔️ Main Battle: July 23 – July 31

🗓️ July 4 – July 31
🃏 Play to win surprise rewards!

🚀 Get ready for the most exciting month of the year!
Stay tuned for more event updates and announcements!
